digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review concurrency overlay eval spec
propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency code-review overlay must be authored to prevent silent regressions in recall/precision behavior against traced race-condition corpus
The spec must define 3 epochs with gate at_least(2), deterministic scorers for validity/recall/no-fire, and include minimial diff hunks distilled from production traces with provenance commits

The spec must include at least 2 scored recall cases (unlocked twin writes, TOCTOU check-then-act) and at least 3 scored no-fire cases (added write lock, atomic-write conversion, deliberate probe-then-skip) covering hard false-positive control
The fail-open guard case (R3) must be included as a non-gating documented stretch comment block (not a scored case) so it cannot fail the gate by construction
The spec must validate successfully via rebar prompt eval exit code and satisfy packaged-spec discipline (unique ids, valid expect vocabulary, balanced dataset, non-empty gold_set)
